ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the figure, the left terminal a is connected to the upper-left node, and terminal b is connected to the lower-left node; R1 vertically connects the upper-left node and the lower-left node. R3 is above, connecting the upper-left node and the upper-right node, and R5 is below, connecting the lower-left node and the lower-right node. R2 is diagonally connected between the upper-left node and the lower-right node, and R4 is diagonally connected between the lower-left node and the upper-right node; when the switch S on the right is closed, the upper-right node and the lower-right node are shorted by a wire into the same node c. Then reason: after S is closed, R2 and R3 are both connected between node a and node c, so R_ac = R2 || R3 = 30 || 30 = 15 Ω. R4 and R5 are both connected between node b and node c, so R_bc = R4 || R5 = 15 || 60 = (15×60)/(15+60) = 12 Ω. The branch through the right common node c is R_ac and R_bc in series, with resistance 15 + 12 = 27 Ω. This 27 Ω branch is in parallel with the left R1 = 90 Ω, therefore R_ab = 90 || 27 = (90×27)/(90+27) = 2430/117 ≈ 20.8 Ω.

method.method_draft: First describe the image topology and merge the right-side nodes due to the closed switch. Apply a test voltage V between a and b, with Va = V and Vb = 0, and call the common right node voltage Vc. KCL at c gives (Vc−V)/R2 + (Vc−V)/R3 + Vc/R4 + Vc/R5 = 0. Substitute R2 = R3 = 30, R4 = 15, R5 = 60 to solve Vc. The source current from terminal a is I = V/R1 + (V−Vc)/R2 + (V−Vc)/R3. Substitute R1 = 90 and the solved Vc, then compute Req = V/I, giving about 20.8 Ω.
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中左侧有两个端子 a、b。a 接到左上节点，b 接到左下节点；R1 竖直连接在左上节点和左下节点之间。上方支路 R3 连接左上节点与右上节点；下方支路 R5 连接左下节点与右下节点。斜向支路中，R2 连接左上节点与右下节点，R4 连接左下节点与右上节点；两条斜线在中央交叉处没有画连接点，因此不作为电连接节点。右侧开关 S 闭合时，右上节点与右下节点短接，合并为同一个节点，记为 c。再推理：在 a、b 两端加测试电压，令 Va = V，Vb = 0，右侧公共节点电压为 Vc。节点 c 与 a 之间有 R2、R3 两个电阻相连，与 b 之间有 R4、R5 两个电阻相连。对节点 c 写 KCL： (Vc−V)/R2 + (Vc−V)/R3 + Vc/R4 + Vc/R5 = 0。代入 R2 = R3 = 30 Ω，R4 = 15 Ω，R5 = 60 Ω，得 (Vc−V)/30 + (Vc−V)/30 + Vc/15 + Vc/60 = 0，即 (Vc−V)/15 + Vc/12 = 0。解得 4(Vc−V)+5Vc=0，所以 9Vc=4V，Vc=4V/9。由端子 a 流入的测试电流为 I = V/R1 + (V−Vc)/R2 + (V−Vc)/R3。代入 R1 = 90 Ω 和 Vc=4V/9，得 I = V/90 + (5V/9)/30 + (5V/9)/30 = V/90 + V/27 = 13V/270。因此等效电阻 Req = V/I = 270/13 Ω ≈ 20.8 Ω。
